debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_dir.description: Directory path where log files are stored.

log_file.description: Optional specific log file name (if null, uses default logging behavior).

log_format.description: Format string for log messages (uses Python logging format syntax).

host.description: Hostname of the introspective monitor instance (must match nova compute host name).

introspective_agent_path.description: Path to the introspective agent binary (must be executable).

health_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks for monitored instances.

host_unhealthy_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) without successful health checks before marking the host unhealthy.

max_failures_before_unhealthy.description: Number of consecutive health check failures before declaring the host unhealthy.

masakari_api_uri.description: Base URI of the Masakari API endpoint.

keystone_auth_url.description: Keystone authentication URL for Masakari API.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name used for Masakari API authentication.

username.description: Username used for Masakari API authentication.

password.description: Password used for Masakari API authentication.

region_name.description: Region name used for Masakari service endpoint lookup (if omitted, uses default region).

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates when connecting to Masakari API.

monitored_instance_ids.description: List of OpenStack instance (VM) UUIDs to monitor (if empty, monitors all instances on this host).

introspective_agent_config.description: Optional config file path to override introspective agent settings.

introspective_agent_log_dir.description: Directory where introspective agent logs are stored.

agent_retry_count.description: Maximum attempts to invoke introspective agent before treating as failure.

agent_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between introspective agent retries.

notifications_enabled.description: Enable sending Masakari notifications on host/instance failure.

transport_url.description: Message broker transport URL for notifications (e.g., RabbitMQ, Redis, or ZMQ).

notification_topics.description: List of notification topics to publish events to (e.g., 'masakari', 'masakari-process').

notification_retry_count.description: Maximum attempts to send notifications before discarding.

notification_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between notification delivery retries.
